title: An angelic guardian.
description: A friend to help those that can't seem to live long in the game.
body:
🌟 Key Features:

Invisible Protector: The Guardian Angel is visible only to the blessed player, ensuring a personal and immersive experience.
Danger Warnings: Your angel will alert you to imminent threats, whether it’s a lurking Creeper, a hidden skeleton, or a zombie. Stay a step ahead of danger!
Passive Buffs: Absorb your Guardian Angel's essence to gain powerful, long-lasting buffs, such as increased speed, faster regeneration, improved strength. Perfect for tackling tough challenges or lengthy expeditions!
Dynamic Gameplay: Switch between keeping your angel as a companion or absorbing its power, adapting to the challenges you face.

⚙️ How It Works:

Obtain Blessing: Earn the angel’s protection through putting a cobble stone block in the center of the crafting table. (only one person should be blessed or it will cause issues)

Angel Abilities: Your angel can sense threats nearby and provide timely warnings, giving you an edge in survival.

Absorption Mechanic: Punch to absorb the angel for unique passive abilities—but remember, the angel’s warning is gone until you release it.

Petting Mechanic: Right click the angel to pet it, giving you a small buff of regeneration but don't pet the angel too much otherwise you will get hunger.

✨ Enhance your survival and immerse yourself in a world where celestial guardians watch over you!
